The two food-pantry doors are reported separately because both movable leaves are visibly open and the instructions require separate treatment of distinct movable parts; their individual opening and closing moments partially overlap and are less certain due to occlusion.
scene_description: A first-person traversal through an apartment kitchen, living area, utility/laundry hallway, and bedroom. The user sequentially opens and later closes appliance doors, a drawer, cabinet doors, utility closets, a room door, and a bedroom closet.
